SITE INFORMATION

Using this website.

Understand the purpose of product summaries and educational resources.

Information and professional care

This website introduces the supplied product portfolio and offers general animal-health education. It does not provide an individual diagnosis or prescription. Obtain the exact current locally authorised leaflet and advice from the attending veterinarian before using a product.

Documentation and availability

Packaging summaries and educational references do not establish regulatory approval in any market. Product availability, authorisation, company history and certifications should be confirmed with current official documentation.

Independent references

Reference links are provided for further reading. Their authors and organisations do not endorse the brands or establish the suitability of the products displayed here. Lifestyle images illustrate care themes and do not document a company facility.
